title: Existence, non-degeneracy and local uniqueness of multi-peak solutions to the fractional Schrödinger equation with nearly critical exponent in $\mathbb{R}^N$
summary: In this paper, we consider the following fractional Schrödinger equation \begin{equation*} \left\{ \begin{array}{lcl} (-Δ)^{s}u+V(x)u=u^{{p_s}-ε}\ \ \ &\hbox{in}\ \mathbb{R}^N,\\ u>0\ \ \ &\hbox{in}\ \mathbb{R}^N, \end{array} \right. \end{equation*} where $0 0$, $p_s=(N+2s)/(N-2s)$, $N>4s$ and $V(x)\in C^1(\mathbb{R}^N)\cap L^\infty (\mathbb{R}^N)$ is non-negative. We first use the Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction method to construct multi-peak solutions to the above equation provided that $V(x)$ possesses $k$ stable critical points.
